Name: PPJA - Farmer to Florist
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: An official port of Kildarien Farmer to Florist mod to JsonAssets.
Description:
[﻿](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231)﻿![](https://i.imgur.com/KcalTzH.png)﻿﻿
Finally the official port of[Kildarien's Farmer to Florist](https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/farmer-to-florist.137119/) for JsonAssets is here! Thanks to the hard work of SpringsSong (uploaded with her permission to Nexus).

﻿ ﻿⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️
IF YOU ARE CONVERTING FROM CFR -> PFM [FOLLOW THIS GUIDE HERE﻿](https://github.com/paradigmnomad/Producer-Framework-Mod---Artisan-Valley)﻿

OR

[USE THIS TOOL](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4972)﻿ PROVIDED BY DIGUS
Your machines _**WILL**_ disappear if you do not follow [the guide](https://github.com/paradigmnomad/Producer-Framework-Mod---Artisan-Valley)﻿ OR [use the tool](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4972)﻿.
⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️

As of 5/22/2020 we are putting Farmer to Florist on permission lockdown as the original creator has strict permissions. This means you cannot do the following:

*   Include Farmer to Florist assets within your mods.

*   Include Farmer to Florist as a dependency for your mod - this does not directly alter F2F but changes what can/cannot be done with the mod which goes against the original intent of the mod.

*   Modify ways the seeds/machines/objects are received (this includes making a working Florist's Table).
We previously allowed users to include F2F as a dependency. If you were granted permission prior to 5/22/2020 you are allowed to continue with it as a dependency.Any future inquires about permissions regarding F2F will be redirected to this statement.

﻿- Install SMAPI, Json Assets, Producer Framework Mod, Better Artisan Goods Icons (optional), and Mail Framework Mod (optional).
- Install any other mods listed and their dependencies.
- Download this mod and extract the zipfile anywhere you want. There are 4 files included in the download.
- Drag + Drop the files directly into the /Mods folder

For Farm Type Manager Part:

- See the [FTM page ](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231)﻿for how to use

Step 1. ﻿Install SMAPI, Json Assets, Producer Framework Mod, Content Patcher, Better Artisan Goods Icons (optional), and Mail Framework Mod (optional).
Step 2. Download this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you would like. There are 4 files included in the download:

[CP] Farmer to Florist
[JA] Farmer to Florist
[MFM] Farmer to Florist
[PFM] Farmer to Florist

Step 3. Drag & Drop the extracted folder(s) directly into the /Mods folder.

![](https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png)﻿

- Delete every existing item made from this mod
- Remove the corresponding folder(s) inside /Mods

**If you miss any (especially in your inventory) you can crash your game.**
